fields.label: Requested By
fields.description: The person raising this. Their name and job title are what the Float Request Form asks for.

fields.label: Activity Date
fields.description: The day the activity runs. The attendance register opens on this date.

fields.label: Activity End Date
fields.description: Leave blank for a one-day activity. Floats are accountable three days after this date.

fields.label: Budget Line
fields.description: The donor budget coding this is charged to, e.g. 2.2.2. Carried onto the float and the expense report.

fields.label: Project
fields.description: The activity everything downstream is scoped by. Opened automatically on approval if left blank.

fields.label: Cash Float Required
fields.description: Tick when a staff member has to hold cash for this activity -- participant transport, per diems, local running. Untick when everything is paid direct to suppliers.

fields.label: Float Held By
fields.description: Who signs for the float and accounts for it. Often not the person raising the requisition.

fields.label: Float Amount
fields.description: How much of the budget goes out as cash. Defaults to the full budget amount.

fields.label: Rejection Reason
fields.description: Why this was rejected or returned. Written when a document is turned down and cleared when it goes back for another attempt -- the wording of each one is kept in the timeline.
